text:
anika: heads up — we're rolling `egress-holdback-v2` to EU tonight at 23:00 UTC. saw several GPU nodes stuck in 'joining' on the canary. looks like keystore calls are getting 403s. anyone else?
kevin: saw the same in staging earlier. logs show `403 AccessDenied: AssumeRole` from priv-keystore-prod-eu. :thinking:
ops-bot: alert: keystore-proxy-eu rate_limited (5xx) — 2026-03-20T23:04:12Z
maria: are we applying a deny-by-default egress policy? that could block privatelink to keystore if rules/tags are missing. who owns the policy?
anika: security applied `egress-holdback-v2` — intent was to block unknown destinations and only allow tagged keystore traffic via tag:keystore-allow. turns out several new keystore instances (and some nodes) don't have the tag.
sre: immediate mitigation required. suggest adding a temporary exception for `priv-keystore.*.redwood-internal` or open egress to 10.200.0.0/16 for the region so nodes can finish onboarding.
tj: temporary exception ok, but opens cost/attack surface. longer-term: either backfill tags on instances or tighten IAM condition so node assume-role requires a tag.
anika: agreed. quick mitigation = ops exception. long fix = infra backfill tags + patch bootstrap to validate tags at startup and failfast early.
kevin: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T23:03:59Z keystore-proxy eu-az1 403 AssumeRoleDenied principal arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/node-role
```
maria: also noticed some audit log gaps — VPC flow logs show `DROP` at natgw for keystore port 443 around the same window. retention/ingest trimmed earliest lines; we should extend retention +7d to ensure forensic coverage for this incident.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1123 — egress-holdback-keystore-eu
anika: who can do the tag backfill? @lina or @kevin?
lina: I can run a backfill job and patch the instance bootstrap. ETA ~30m. i'll also add a health-check that logs missing tags to help detect regressions.
tj: please coordinate with security before changing the policy. @security FYI.
security: ack. we'll temporize the policy for 1 hour and audit any exceptions. please attach the deployment PR and a concrete allowlist of IPs/CIDRs.
maria: quick allowlist: priv-keystore-eu-prd: 10.200.12.0/24, priv-keystore-eu-stg: 10.200.13.0/24 (uploading to the incident thread).
anika: thanks — ops, apply the exception and keep this thread updated. :eyes:
ops-bot: change applied: `egress-holdback-v2` exception added for 10.200.12.0/24, 10.200.13.0/24 — 2026-03-20T23:35:00Z
sre: nodes began joining again after exception. verifying warm pool sizes and bootstrap logs.
kevin: follow-up: i'll open a PR to enforce tag linting on instance images + add an IAM condition on the node role to require `aws:ResourceTag/keystore-allow` before AssumeRole. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6789
anika: perf/cost note: keeping allowlist exceptions will increase egress-metered costs ~0.8% for EU traffic while exception is live — recommend charging to central infra budget.
maria: noted. i'll add cost delta to INC-2026-1123. postmortem required if we need to roll back the policy.
tj: who will own the postmortem? @anika?
anika: i'll own it. tentative timeline: incident opened 23:04, exception applied 23:35, recovery observed 23:52. i'll write up MTTA/MTTR and mitigation plan.
sre: moving the detailed notes into INC-2026-1123 and incidents channel. closing this slack thread — followups in the incident. :white_check_mark:
